boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named UTampa destinations for studying, creating, reflecting, exercising and attending campus programming.

cards.title: Macdonald-Kelce Library
cards.subtitle: Two floors of study space
cards.notes: Bring your Spartan ID for a study room when you need project space or a private study session; research librarians can also help locate materials.
cards.short_summary: A two-story library with research support and reservable or individual study options.
cards.evidence_claim: UTampa says the library has two stories of study spaces and Spartan-ID access to study rooms for group projects or private study.
cards.access_notes: Student study-room access requires a Spartan ID card.

cards.title: Scarfone/Hartley Gallery
cards.subtitle: R.K. Bailey Art Studios
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition, then use the display as a close-looking break between classes; the gallery presents student and professional work.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery where exhibitions connect classroom learning with original artwork.
cards.evidence_claim: The gallery exhibits student, faculty and professional work and frames its exhibitions as an extension of the classroom.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Monday–Friday hours of 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; confirm exhibition availability before visiting.

cards.title: Ferman Center for the Arts
cards.subtitle: Fine and performing arts building
cards.notes: Use the building’s designated study areas between arts classes, rehearsals or performances, and check the arts calendar for scheduled public events.
cards.short_summary: A four-story arts facility with collaborative practice studios and study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: UTampa states that the Ferman Center offers collaborative practice studios, study spaces and flexible performance staging.
cards.access_notes: Academic and performance spaces may have scheduled use; follow posted access guidance.

cards.entity_name: Sykes Chapel and Center for Faith and Values
cards.title: Sykes Chapel and Center for Faith and Values
cards.subtitle: Meditation and prayer space
cards.notes: Use the main hall for quiet reflection during posted hours, or look for the designated meditation rooms when you need a more focused pause.
cards.short_summary: A campus setting for reflection, prayer, meditation and interfaith programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UTampa describes the center as a setting for meditation and celebration of all faiths, with student-oriented reflection and learning.
cards.source_title: Sykes Chapel and Center for Faith and Values
cards.access_notes: The building’s prayer and meditation spaces operate on posted hours and may be shared during musical rehearsals.

cards.entity_name: Sykes Plaza and Susan and John Sykes Ars Sonora
cards.title: Sykes Plaza and Ars Sonora
cards.subtitle: Plaza beside Sykes Chapel
cards.notes: Pause at the seating and fountain area between destinations, and look up at the bell installation that anchors this outdoor campus gathering space.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor plaza designed around the Ars Sonora bell installation.
cards.evidence_claim: UTampa calls the Ars Sonora the centerpiece of Sykes Plaza and describes the plaza as a place for inspiration, reflection and entertainment.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor plaza; use normal campus visitor and event guidance.

cards.title: Riseman Aquatic Center
cards.subtitle: Pool complex and sun deck
cards.notes: Check the facility schedule before going, then use the sun deck for reading, studying or relaxing when the recreation center is open to you.
cards.short_summary: A campus pool complex with a lap pool, leisure pool and student-oriented sun deck.
cards.evidence_claim: UTampa says the aquatic center’s sun deck gives students a place for tanning, studying or listening to music.
cards.access_notes: Access and pool availability follow Campus Recreation operating hours and policies.

cards.entity_name: Benson Alex Riseman Fitness and Recreation Center
cards.title: Riseman Fitness and Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Campus recreation hub
cards.notes: Bring a valid Spartan ID and choose a workout, group exercise or informal recreation option that fits your schedule and current facility rules.
cards.short_summary: A central recreation facility for exercise, wellness, intramurals and club sports.
cards.evidence_claim: UTampa describes the center as a one-stop site for exercise programs, wellness, intramurals, recreation activities and club sports.
cards.access_notes: UTampa students receive an annual membership and must bring a valid Spartan ID; operating hours vary by term.

cards.title: Cass Gym
cards.subtitle: Recreation and student-organization venue
cards.notes: Look for intramural schedules or a registered student-organization event, and confirm the gym is not reserved before planning a recreational visit.
cards.short_summary: A gymnasium used for recreational sports, intramurals and registered student-organization events.
cards.evidence_claim: UTampa says Cass Gym serves as a recreational sports venue and a rental space for registered student organizations; intramurals typically run there in season.
cards.access_notes: Academic classes, club sports and intramurals take precedence over other reservations.

cards.title: Plant Park
cards.subtitle: Green space next to Plant Hall
cards.notes: Use the park as an outdoor meet-up point or a place to attend scheduled campus programming; keep to established paths and posted event setups.
cards.short_summary: A named campus green space used for student-focused outdoor activities.
cards.evidence_claim: UTampa’s student-involvement page depicts students participating in a goat-yoga activity in Plant Park, and the campus map lists Plant Park.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor programming varies; follow event-specific instructions and campus policies.

cards.title: David Falk Theatre
cards.subtitle: Historic campus performance venue
cards.notes: Check the arts calendar for student productions or dance events, then plan around the performance’s stated entry and seating instructions.
cards.short_summary: A historic, 1,000-seat campus theater used for student stage productions and dance events.
cards.evidence_claim: UTampa says student productions and dance events take place at David Falk Theatre, a fully equipped historic theater built in 1928.
cards.access_notes: Performance access depends on the specific event; consult its listing before attending.
